Subject: Mutual Action Plan + Signoff Matrix / Acceptance Tests for CareBridge POC

Hi Anika —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP_CareBridge_v1.xlsx) and a short list of proposed acceptance tests (eval-test-cases.md). I want to make the success criteria explicit so your evaluation team can run deterministic checks and we can avoid surprises at close.

High-level asks from us:
- Can you review the acceptance-test cases and call out any clinical/regulatory checks we miss?
- Confirm the three acceptance thresholds below so we have a single pass/fail definition:
  1) Latency: 95th percentile < 400 ms for 512-token prompts during parallel load test (50 concurrent).
  2) Precision: task-specific F1 >= 0.78 on the CareBridge validation set v1 (we included a sample export).
  3) Data controls: KV-cache and inference logs must be retained for 90 days within your VPC (if using private deploy) or encrypted-at-rest if hosted.

I've annotated the MAP with owners and dates for each milestone. Proposed close timeline: 6-week evaluation starting 2026-09-01 with milestone signoffs at weeks 2, 4 and final acceptance at week 6.

If that works, reply with any modifications and I'll lock the version and send to procurement for SOW alignment.

Attachments: MAP_CareBridge_v1.xlsx; eval-test-cases.md

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0172

Lauren —

Thanks, appreciate the clear starting point. A few quick notes after a pass with our clinical lead:
1) Latency: 400 ms 95p is aggressive but acceptable as a target; operationally we need a soft-fail tolerance where UX shows degraded state if 95p > 600ms. Can you add an automatic fallback rule to a smaller model variant?
2) Precision/F1: the team wants two thresholds: 
   - Gate A (pilot acceptable): F1 >= 0.72 on the v1 set
   - Gate B (production-ready): F1 >= 0.78 on v2 (larger, holdout)
3) Data controls: we use a SaaS VPC pattern for new vendors. Can you provide a short write-up on encryption-at-rest plus access logging? We need an artifact for our infosec questionnaire.

Also, can you move the final acceptance signoff to 2026-10-05? Our procurement cycle requires a 2-week legal review after the SOW.

I attached a short commentary in the eval-test-cases.md thread and flagged two test cases around hallucination detection and entity redaction.

Best,
Anika
Director of Product, CareBridge Health
